// A typed wrapper around localStorage that survives parse errors: a corrupt
// entry reads as absent instead of throwing on every page load.

interface Storable {
  version: number;
  savedAt: string;
}

type Load = (raw: unknown) => Storable | null;

const KEY_PREFIX = "app:v1:";

/* read parses the JSON under key and validates it with load; anything that
   does not survive the round trip reads as the fallback. */
function read(key: string, load: Load, fallback: Storable): Storable {
  try {
    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY_PREFIX + key);
    if (raw === null) {
      return fallback;
    }
    const parsed = load(JSON.parse(raw));
    return parsed ?? fallback;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn(`dropping corrupt entry ${key}:`, error);
    return fallback;
  }
}

function write(key: string, value: Storable): void {
  const text = JSON.stringify({ ...value, savedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  window.localStorage.setItem(KEY_PREFIX + key, text);
}

// Count how many saved sessions are older than a week.
function staleCount(names: string[]): number {
  const cutoff = Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  return names.filter((name) => {
    const entry = read(name, (raw) => raw as Storable, { version: 0, savedAt: "" });
    return Date.parse(entry.savedAt) < cutoff;
  }).length;
}

export { read, write, staleCount };
